summary: A message in a raised card, its tone shown on the icon tile, with an optional action and close button.

props.name: icon
props.description: A glyph in the tile, in place of the tone's own icon.

props.name: action
props.description: A button at the end, such as Upgrade.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Shows a close button, and is called when it is pressed.

props.name: dismissLabel
props.description: What the close button says to a screen reader.

props.name: tone
props.description: What the alert means; it colors the icon tile only.

props.name: shape
props.description: Corner radius of the alert & its tile. Inherits the nearest `Shape`.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. `merge` folds them in last, so one here replaces the component's own class for the same utility.

props.name: focus
props.description: The focus outline. `true` draws it, `false` removes it along with the danger, error and success tints that ride with it, and a string of Yumma CSS utilities restyles it on every focusable part of the component, which is more than `className` reaches. Removing it outright and putting nothing back fails WCAG 2.4.7.
